```{r}
#“Distances are multiplied with the friction, thus to get the cost-distance, the friction surface must express the cost per unit distance (speed) of travel”

# Workflow

setup_terra_for_large_rasters(
  tempdir = paste0(WKDir, "output_wol/temp/"),
  memfrac = 0.6,
  verbose = TRUE
)

 cost <- load_cost_raster(paste0(WKDir,"data_wol/processing/wol/cost.tif"))
 track <- load_tracks(paste0(WKDir,"data_wol/tracks/tracks_clean.rds"))
 burn_tracks(cost, track, filename=paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/burn.tif"))
 burn <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/burn.tif"))

run_cost_dist(burn, filename= (paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_surface.tif")), tmp_fn= (paste0(WKDir,"output/temp/")), overwrite = TRUE, maxiter = 25)

cost_surface <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_surface.tif"))

cost_surface_wol <-  terra::crop(cost_surface, vect(np_wol_gda94), mask=TRUE) # run and check
terra::writeRaster(cost_surface_wol, paste0(WKDir, "output_wol/cost_surface_wol.tif"), overwrite = TRUE) ## Commented out to prevent re-writing
```

# combining inat and herb
```{r}
# combining herb and iNat
occ_wol_comb <- rbind(occ_wol_gda94, occ_wol_herb_gda94)
occ_wol_comb <- dplyr::bind_rows(list(occ_wol_gda94, occ_wol_herb_gda94), .id = 'source') 
occ_wol_comb <- occ_wol_comb %>%
    mutate(source = recode(source, "1" = "iNaturalist", "2" = "Herbarium"))

occ_wol_cost <- pts_cost(occ_wol_comb, cost_surface_wol) # point cost
```

```{r}
occ_wol_cost <- occ_wol_cost %>% filter(uncertainty < 300) # filtering out points with more than 300m of uncertainty in location
tax_resources <- load_taxonomic_resources() # load this first run of session
status <- native_anywhere_in_australia(as.list(occ_wol_cost$species), resources = tax_resources) # using APCalign to extract native/introduced status
occ_wol_cost <- cbind(occ_wol_cost, status$native_anywhere_in_aus)

occ_wol_cost <- occ_wol_cost %>%
  mutate(status.native_anywhere_in_aus = recode(status.native_anywhere_in_aus,
                         "introduced" = "Introduced",
                         "native" = "Native",
                         "unknown" = "Only identified to genus or above"))
```


```{r}
occ_wol_text <- occ_wol_cost %>% filter(pts_cost > 300) # creating a subset of labels for plotting

buff <- st_buffer(np_wol_gda94, dist = 500, nQuadSegs = 30) # 500m buffer for plotting
tr_wol <- st_intersection(wol_tr_gda94, buff) 

occ_wol_cost <- dist_points_to_path(occ_wol_cost, tr_wol) # Calculates crow distance from point to the path.
```

```{r}

extract  <-ext_slope(occ_wol_cost$geometry, slope_wol)
extract <- subset(extract, select = -geometry)
occ_wol_cost <- cbind(occ_wol_cost, extract)

grid_wol_comb <- grid_points_cost(n = nrow(occ_wol_cost), np_outline = np_wol_gda94, tr = tr_wol, cost_surface = cost_surface_wol)

grid_sf_slope <- ext_slope(grid_wol_comb$geometry, slope_wol)
grid_sf_slope <- subset(grid_sf_slope, select = -geometry)
grid_wol_comb <-cbind(grid_wol_comb , grid_sf_slope)

ggplot() +
geom_histogram(data=grid_wol_comb, mapping=aes(x=slope), binwidth = 5,boundary = 0, position = "identity",fill="grey90", colour="grey90") +
geom_histogram(data=occ_wol_cost, mapping= aes(x = slope, fill=source),binwidth = 5,boundary = 0, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), alpha=0.5) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name = "Source") +
            scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
          scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01))+
  labs(x="Slope (Degrees)", y= "Count")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = c(.98, .98),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
                legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.margin = margin(2,2,2,2))

ggsave(
       filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/plots/slope_wol.png"),
       width = 7,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300
     )
```




```{r}
bb <- st_bbox(np_wol)
# download file download.geofabrik.de/australia-oceania/australia
osm_data_wol <- st_read(
  dsn = file.path("/Users/z5161362/OneDrive - DPIE/Documents/PhD/spatRast/map data/australia-260401-free.shp"),
  layer = "gis_osm_roads_free_1",
  quiet = TRUE
)

osm_lines_wol <- osm_data_wol
osm_gda94_wol <- st_transform(osm_lines_wol, crs = crs(cost_surface_wol))
bb_wol <- st_bbox(np_wol_gda94)
osm_background_wol <- st_crop(osm_gda94_wol, bb_wol)
osm_road_wol <- osm_background_wol[
  osm_background_wol$fclass %in% c(
    "trunk", "primary", "primary_link",
    "secondary", "secondary_link",
    "tertiary", "tertiary_link",
    "motorway", "motorway_link"
  ),
]

tr_wol_croped <- st_intersection(tr_wol, np_wol_gda94)




occ_wol_cost_inat$status.native_anywhere_in_aus <- factor(
  occ_wol_cost_inat$status.native_anywhere_in_aus,
  levels = c("Native","Only identified to genus or above", "Introduced")
)
occ_wol_cost_inat <- occ_wol_cost_inat[order(occ_wol_cost_inat$status.native_anywhere_in_aus == "Only identified to genus or above"), ]

```

```{r}
# Creating small box
bbox <- ext(150.235, 150.26, -33.185, -33.16)
bbox_vect <- as.polygons(bbox)
crs(bbox_vect) <- "EPSG:4326"   # correct CRS for lon/lat
bbox_proj <- project(bbox_vect, crs(cost_surface_wol))

crop_cost_surface_wol <- terra::crop(cost_surface_wol, bbox_proj, mask = FALSE)

crop_wol_tr_gda94 <- st_crop(tr_wol_croped, bbox_proj)

crop_osm_background_wol <- st_crop(osm_background_wol, bbox_proj)
crop_osm_road_wol <- st_crop(osm_road_wol, bbox_proj)
crop_ml_wol <- st_crop(ml_wol, bbox_proj)


bbox_sf <- st_as_sf(bbox_proj)
occ_wol_cost_herb_sf <- st_as_sf(occ_wol_cost_herb, sf_column_name = "geometry", crs = st_crs(bbox_proj))
crop_occ_wol_cost_herb <- st_crop(occ_wol_cost_herb_sf, bbox_sf)

occ_wol_cost_inat_sf <- st_as_sf(occ_wol_cost_inat, sf_column_name = "geometry", crs = st_crs(bbox_proj))
crop_occ_wol_cost_inat <- st_crop(occ_wol_cost_inat_sf, bbox_sf)

```

```{r}
cost_plot <-  
    ggplot() +
    
    # cost surface 
    geom_spatraster(data = crop_cost_surface_wol, maxcell=10000000,alpha=70,) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours=grDevices::hcl.colors(50, "YlOrBr", rev = TRUE), limits = c(0, 7), na.value = "white",name="Cost (Estimated hours)") +
    
    # Tracks background
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_background_wol, aes(geometry=geometry), key_glyph = draw_key_path, col="grey85", lwd=0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_road_wol, aes(geometry=geometry),col="grey70", key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    # Tracks
    geom_sf(data = crop_wol_tr_gda94, aes(geometry=geometry, color = highway_com), key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#88BBAA","#5566AA","#BB0011","#E69F00"), name ="Track Type") + 
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    
    # points
    geom_sf(data = crop_occ_wol_cost_inat, aes(colour = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), size = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), geometry = geometry), shape = 16, stroke = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#666633","#99BB55","orange"), name = "Native Status" ) +
    scale_size_manual(values =c(2, 2,2),name = "Native Status")+
    
    geom_text(data = crop_ml_wol, aes(label = location, geometry = geometry), col="grey40", stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3) +
  annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.2) +
    
    # plot design
    coord_sf() +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill="grey90")) +
    scale_x_continuous( expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +

    labs(x = "", y="")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/plots/crop_cost_rast_wol_inat.png"),
    width = 10,
    height = 15,
    dpi = 300)
```

#testing tracks?

```{r}
cost <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"data_wol/processing/wol/cost.tif"))
tr_buff <- st_buffer(wol_tr_gda94, dist=30, nQuadSegs = 30)
crop_to_track <-terra::crop(cost, tr_buff, mask=TRUE, touches=TRUE)

tr_road <- tr_buff %>% filter(highway_com=="road")

setup_terra_for_large_rasters(
  tempdir = paste0("/Users/z5161362/Downloads/temp/"),
  memfrac = 0.6,
  verbose = TRUE
)

burn_tracks(crop_to_track, tr_road, filename=paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/burn_tracks.tif"))
burn_tr <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/burn_tracks.tif"))

run_cost_dist(burn_tr, filename= (paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_track.tif")), tmp_fn= ("/Users/z5161362/Downloads/temp/"), overwrite = TRUE, maxiter = 25)
cost_tr <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_track.tif"))
plot(cost_tr)
```

# Tracks plot here


```{r}
# SMALL test 

# Creating small box
bbox <- ext(150.230, 150.280, -33.190, -33.140)
bbox_vect <- as.polygons(bbox)
crs(bbox_vect) <- "EPSG:4283"  
bbox_proj <- project(bbox_vect, crs(cost))
cost_crop_sm <- crop(cost, bbox_proj, mask = TRUE) # Cost
wol_tr_crop_sm <- st_crop(wol_tr_gda94, bbox_proj, mask = TRUE) # Tracks
plot(cost_crop_sm)

cost_sm <- load_cost_raster(cost_crop_sm)
track_sm <- load_tracks(wol_tr_crop_sm)
burn_sm <- burn_tracks(cost_sm, track_sm, tmp_fn= (paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/temp/")))
cost_surface_sm<- run_cost_dist(burn_sm, filename= (paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_surface_sm.tif")), overwrite=TRUE)
cost_surface_sm <- terra::rast(paste0(WKDir,"output_wol/cost_surface_sm.tif"))
plot_cost_with_tracks(cost_surface_sm, tracks = track_sm, filename = "output_wol/plots/cost_rast_sm.png")

# Raster CRS: GDA94 / MGA zone 56 (EPSG:28356)
# Tracks CRS: GDA94 / MGA zone 56 (EPSG:28356)

ext(cost_crop_sm)
```
